config_hideUntilFixed_label: hide prediction until performances are fixed
config_useFinalResultOnVirtual_label: use final result as a performance reference during the virtual participation
config_useFinalResultOnVirtual_descripti: If enabled, the performance is calculated as if the original participant had already done the contest.
config_language_reload_hint: Reload the page to apply the language change.
config_dataSource_description: Optional. A mirror or reverse proxy that serves ac-predictor-data files directly (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/). It is tried first; if empty, data.ac-predictor.com, raw.githubusercontent.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net are tried in order. Note: this is not an HTTP proxy port such as Clash — your browser/system proxy is used automatically.
config_dataSource_placeholder: leave empty to use built-in sources
config_requestTimeout_description: If a data source does not respond within this time, the next one is tried. Increase it if your proxy is slow.
notice_aperf_estimated: Upstream prediction data (aperf) is unavailable. Performances and rating changes are approximations estimated from each participant's current rating (on past contests they differ from the normal prediction by about 10-15 on average).
notice_aperf_estimated_heuristic: Upstream prediction data (aperf) is unavailable. Performances and rating changes are approximations estimated from each participant's current rating. For heuristic contests the error is larger (about 50 on average on past contests).
notice_load_failed: ac-predictor failed to load prediction data.
standings_load_failed_label: failed to load prediction data (see the notice above the standings)
